use_case: AI estimating and bid assistant: quantity takeoff from drawings, unit pricing from the historical cost database, subcontractor bid leveling and recommendations, and proposal drafting
vendor_or_model: AI estimating SaaS vendor (computer vision takeoff plus a generative language model with retrieval over the company cost database)
data_categories: Drawings and specifications (FCI on awarded federal contracts; owners' confidential drawings); historical costs and bid pricing; subcontractor bids and contact details
affects_individuals: Yes (subcontractor firms and their owners, indirectly)
consequential_decision_category: None directly (business decisions about bids and subcontractors); re-tier to High if used for hiring, crew assignment, or life-safety quantities
risk_tier: Medium (with elevated controls set by the committee)
human_in_the_loop: Estimator verifies every takeoff for major trades and decides every subcontractor selection; preconstruction director approves every bid; federal price certifications signed only after the pooled-pricing check
applicable_laws: FAR 52.204-21(b)(1)(iii) and DFARS 252.204-7021(d)(2) if FCI is uploaded; FAR 52.203-2; FAR 15.403-4 when certified cost or pricing data are required; FAR 52.219-8 and 52.219-9; Sherman Act Sec. 1 (counsel); FTC Act Sec. 5 (vendor claims)
status: In production for private and public non-federal bids (about 120 estimators); federal use limited (section 7)
federal_data_allowed: No FCI until enterprise terms are signed; no CUI ever
monitoring: Quarterly accuracy by trade and project type; quarterly recommendation ratios; monthly pooled-pricing feature check

federal_data_allowed: FCI yes (inside the Level 1 scope); CUI no (FPCE only)
monitoring: Monthly usage and DLP events; quarterly prompt sample review
